summary: K Wave Media Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency letter for failing to meet the $15 million Market Value of Publicly Held Shares (MVPHS) requirement for continued listing on the Nasdaq Global Market. The company has a 180-day compliance period until December 14, 2026, to regain compliance by achieving a closing MVPHS of $15 million or more for ten consecutive business days. If unable to comply, Nasdaq may initiate delisting proceedings, though the company may appeal or transfer to the Nasdaq Capital Market. KWM is evaluating options, including a strategic transformation toward AI investments and potential rebranding subject to shareholder approval at the July 10, 2026 annual meeting. The filing is a routine notification of a listing standard deficiency, not a special situation.
